messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Levothyroxine is a man-made form of thyroxine (T4), one of the hormones your thyroid gland normally produces.
Levothyroxine belongs to a class of medications called hormones.
Levothyroxine works by replacing thyroid hormone that your body is not making enough of.
Levothyroxine is used in adults and children, including newborn babies, to:
treat hypothyroidism (underactive thyroid - a condition where the thyroid gland does not produce enough thyroid hormone).
Levothyroxine replaces the missing hormone whether the condition was present from birth or developed later.
It replaces the missing hormone whether the problem starts in the thyroid gland itself or in the pituitary gland or hypothalamus.
lower the level of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) in the blood in people being treated for a certain type of thyroid cancer, alongside surgery and radioactive iodine therapy.
Levothyroxine injection is used in adults to treat myxedema coma.
Myxedema coma is a rare and life-threatening complication.
Myxedema coma is a complication of a severely underactive thyroid.
Triplet: ["Levothyroxine", "replaces missing hormone in", "thyroid gland issues"]

The relation 'replaces missing hormone in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used to replace the missing hormone in the condition or issue specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:

B. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
